verdict.rationale: Penpot's docs confirm an inspect capability that surfaces matching code in open standards (CSS, HTML, SVG, JSON) tied to design objects, which covers much of the developer inspect/handoff need, and Penpot is free/open-source so there's no paid 'editor seat' barrier implied by unlimited teams/files pricing. However, the evidence never mentions iOS/Android-specific code snippets (only CSS/HTML/SVG/JSON) nor explicitly describes a dedicated free 'viewer' role for inspection without an editing license. Missing for 10: iOS/Android code snippet generation, explicit no-seat/viewer-role inspect workflow documentation, independent hands-on confirmation of the inspect panel.
